desc: SUMMIT OTR24 is a microwave oven designed for enclosed built-in installation above or below the counter. The front-venting OTR24 is conveniently featured with touchpad controls for easy heating.
hl: Included with the microwave to help fit the overall unit into standard 24" wide spaces
Must be fully enclosed in a cabinet or shelf for safe operation
Microwave ships with a trim kit designed to allow installation in 24" wide cabinet openings
Digital controls let you set the heat with ease
Options include popcorn, pizza, beverage heating and more
Dark-tinted reflective glass adds modern style to the kitchen
